title: The Lantern Fox
story: In a misty wood, a small fox carried a lantern. The light never burned the fox, and it showed hidden stones across a black stream. Lila followed the stones to a tree with a silver door. The fox set the lantern down and the door opened. Inside, books whispered their titles. Lila read one page, thanked the fox, and promised to return the lantern at dawn.
